'''Maples''' are a type of [[above ground]] [[tree]]. They are found in nearly any [[temperate]] region with [[plants|vegetation]]. Like the overwhelming majority of overland trees, maple [[carpenter|wood]] is brown and produces brown products. 

There is no current means to extract maple syrup from maple trees. Cut them freely.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] maples for their ''autumn coloration''.
